title: SourceCapability
description: Capabilities that a source connector can declare. The orchestration layer only calls methods the connector has declared. Never assume a platform supports all capabilities.

x-capability-descriptions.SEARCH: Connector can execute keyword/semantic search queries and return result lists
x-capability-descriptions.FETCH: Connector can fetch a specific URL or item by ID and return its content
x-capability-descriptions.COMMENTS: Connector can fetch comments/replies on a given post or page
x-capability-descriptions.REPLIES: Connector can fetch threaded replies to a specific comment
x-capability-descriptions.PUBLIC_ENTITY: Connector can fetch a public profile or entity page
x-capability-descriptions.STREAM: Connector supports real-time streaming of new items
x-capability-descriptions.PUBLISH: Connector can publish content (requires explicit permission + autonomy level 4+)
x-capability-descriptions.ANALYTICS: Connector can retrieve engagement analytics for owned content
x-capability-descriptions.BROWSER_RENDER: Connector uses a headless browser for JavaScript-rendered pages
x-capability-descriptions.HISTORICAL_SEARCH: Connector can retrieve historical items beyond the default recency window
x-capability-descriptions.INCREMENTAL_SYNC: Connector supports cursor-based incremental sync (fetches only new items since last cursor)
x-capability-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_AWARE: Connector has built-in rate limit tracking and will throw RateLimitExceeded
